title: Lower Body Strength & Power for Engelbrektsloppet 45km

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move smoothly through each rep, synchronizing breath with movement. Warm up the spine and prepare core.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Controlled movements, feel hip mobility in both positions. Prepares hips for loaded patterns.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg, maintain neutral spine throughout. Activate core stabilizers.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Drive through heels, chest up, knees tracking over toes. Build strength for hill climbing on course. Rest fully between sets.

items.name: Bent Over Row
items.cues: Hinge at hips, maintain neutral spine, drive elbows back explosively. Strengthen posterior chain for posture and power.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.cues: Front leg drives the movement, rear leg elevated on bench. Builds unilateral leg strength critical for technical terrain.

items.name: Cable Pull-Through
items.cues: Hip hinge pattern, explosive hip extension, glute focus. Builds posterior chain power for sustained running.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold stretch on step or wall, feel calf elongation. Hold for 30 seconds each leg, two reps.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Arm extended against wall, gentle pressure. Hold 30 seconds each side.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.cues: Knees wide, sink hips to heels, arms extended. Breathe deeply to recover and lower heart rate.

rationale: With 20 days until Engelbrektsloppet 45km (demanding ultra trail race), this strength session focuses on lower body power and posterior chain development needed for sustained climbing and technical terrain.

Recent training shows two 15-minute strength sessions completed today; this 45-minute session provides deeper strength stimulus at moderate intensity (RPE 6-7) without excessive fatigue, respecting the back-to-back training while building capacity.

Exercise selection prioritizes bilateral and unilateral lower body strength (Back Squat, Bulgarian Split Squat, Pull-Through) combined with posterior chain integrity (Bent Over Row) to prevent injury and improve efficiency for 45km distance racing.
